lines.text: Has this ever happened? Shuffle a deck, and look at the order.
lines.phonemes: hɐz ðɪs ˈɛvɚ hˈæpənd? ʃˈʌfəl ɐ dˈɛk, ænd lˈʊk æt ðɪ ˈɔːɹdɚ.

lines.text: The first card can be any of fifty-two, the next any of the rest. Multiply all those choices, and you count the orders.
lines.phonemes: ðə fˈɜːst kˈɑːɹd kæn biː ˌɛni ʌv fˈɪftitˈuː, ðə nˈɛkst ˌɛni ʌvðə ɹˈɛst. mˌʌltɪplˈaɪ ˈɔːl ðoʊz tʃˈɔɪsᵻz, ænd juː kˈaʊnt ðɪ ˈɔːɹdɚz.

lines.text: The answer has sixty-eight digits, too big to say out loud. Each shuffle is just one pick from that huge pile.
lines.phonemes: ðɪ ˈænsɚ hɐz sˈɪkstiˈeɪt dˈɪdʒɪts, tˈuː bˈɪɡ tə sˈeɪ ˈaʊt lˈaʊd. ˈiːtʃ ʃˈʌfəl ɪz dʒˈʌst wˈʌn pˈɪk fɹʌm ðæt hjˈuːdʒ pˈaɪl.

lines.text: Now give everyone alive a deck, eight billion of us. Shuffle once a second for fourteen billion years, the age of the universe.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ ɡˈɪv ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn ɐlˈaɪv ɐ dˈɛk, ˈeɪt bˈɪliən ʌv ˌʌs. ʃˈʌfəl wˈʌns ɐ sˈɛkənd fɔːɹ fˈɔːɹtiːn bˈɪliən jˈɪɹz, ðɪ ˈeɪdʒ ʌvðə jˈuːnɪvˌɜːs.

lines.text: Even then, you cover less than one part in a trillion trillion trillion of the orders. Your shuffle is almost certainly the first of its kind.
lines.phonemes: ˈiːvən ðˈɛn, juː kˈʌvɚ lˈɛs ðɐn wˈʌn pˈɑːɹt ɪn ɐ tɹˈɪliən tɹˈɪliən tɹˈɪliən ʌvðɪ ˈɔːɹdɚz. jʊɹ ʃˈʌfəl ɪz ˈɔːlmoʊst sˈɜːʔnli ðə fˈɜːst ʌv ɪts kˈaɪnd.

lines.text: Give the planet a thousand times more shufflers, and it barely changes. The pile of orders is just too big.
lines.phonemes: ɡˈɪv ðə plˈænɪt ɐ θˈaʊzənd tˈaɪmz mˈɔːɹ ʃˈʌflɚz, ænd ɪt bˈɛɹli tʃˈeɪndʒᵻz. ðə pˈaɪl ʌv ˈɔːɹdɚz ɪz dʒˈʌst tˈuː bˈɪɡ.

lines.text: Shuffle well, and your order has almost certainly never existed before. Not certain, but a very safe bet.
lines.phonemes: ʃˈʌfəl wˈɛl, ænd jʊɹ ˈɔːɹdɚ hɐz ˈɔːlmoʊst sˈɜːʔnli nˈɛvɚɹ ɛɡzˈɪstᵻd bᵻfˈɔːɹ. nˌɑːt sˈɜːʔn, bˌʌt ɐ vˈɛɹi sˈeɪf bˈɛt.

lines.text: Next envelope: all the water on Earth, in one ball.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst ˈɑːnvəlˌoʊp: ˈɔːl ðə wˈɔːɾɚɹ ˌɔn ˈɜːθ, ɪn wˈʌn bˈɔːl.
